summary: Frontend-only retest using Playwright on the public URL. (4) Mobile overflow at 390px: document.documentElement.scrollWidth is 390 on all 9 owner pages (/dashboard, bestellingen, menu, categorieen, bezorging, openingstijden, instellingen, profiel, personeel), on super admin /dashboard/platform and on /dashboard/platform/<Bistro Demo id> (read-only), and on /, /privacy and /order/bistro-demo. An element-level scan found no non-fixed element whose right edge goes past the viewport. The old overflows are gone (Overview order-link card, Profile delete buttons, Staff rows). The mobile drawer opens, shows the correct nav and closes after navigating. The add-menu-item dialog opens, accepts input and closes with Escape. Desktop at 1920 has no overflow. (5) ScrollToTop: footer link navigation from the bottom of /privacy to terms, cookies, legal and contact gives scrollY 0 every time. Landing (scrollY 1020) to privacy gives 0. Browser back (POP) restores the previous position (247 on /legal, 1020 on landing), forward works, and nothing breaks. (6) Regression: the owner nav has all 9 items including Personeel. Staff has 8 items without Personeel or Platform, and staff going to /dashboard/personeel or /dashboard/platform is redirected to /dashboard. Super admin sees only Platform, the Platform page with the Archived section (Sushi To Home) renders, the Manage detail page renders, and super admin going to /dashboard/menu is redirected to /dashboard/platform. Registering TEST_Reg 88619 leads to the dashboard with the verify-email banner, then logout and re-login work. The public pickup order on bistro-demo (restaurant was open) gave order #1318 and the status page. All TEST data was deleted: the restaurant, user, verification token and order #1318. No page errors were seen.

issues: For about 1 second the header shows 'Upxero' and the stats show '—' until /auth/me resolves. It then correctly shows the restaurant name and 0s. Cosmetic only.
The Sonner 'Welcome back!' toast (top-right) covers the hamburger/menu header on 390px for a few seconds. Consider position='top-center' with an offset, or a bottom position, on mobile.
The dialog is edge-to-edge (width ~389px, no side margin). It is usable, but adding a small inset would look better.

Already like this before this change: staff sees edit forms on Menu, Categories, Delivery, Opening hours and Settings, but the backend uses admin_only for those mutations, so Save returns 403. Consider read-only UI for staff or hiding those nav items.
Dates still use Dutch month abbreviations ('30 sep, 16:33'). Already reported in iteration 11.

action_items: Optional: on mobile, move the Toaster so it does not cover the dashboard header
Optional: make staff-facing edit pages read-only, or hide them, since saving returns 403
Optional: show a loading skeleton instead of 'Upxero' while the restaurant is loading
critical_code_review_comments: ScrollToTop is correct: it skips POP and hash navigations, and depends on pathname, so query-only changes do not scroll. This is good.
DashboardIndex redirects super_admin to /platform, and forRestaurant guards all restaurant routes. Verified by redirect.
Bistro Demo has a staff user 'mike_bernard@live.nl' (it looks real). It was not touched.
